name: Crew Currency Management and Ask Moove AI assistant (Moove)
summary: French business aviation booking and scheduling company Moove has added a Crew Currency Management System to its Instant Booking Engine, along with Ask Moove, an AI conversational assistant, Business Air News reported on November 1. The currency system lets corporate flight departments and charter operators build their own crew currency rules into scheduling and trip requests, including complex ones such as the FAA night-with-turbine-alternate rule in 14 CFR 61.57(e)(4), so they can check that a qualified crew is available before a flight is confirmed through the customer booking page. Ask Moove answers plain-language questions across Moove's reporting, scheduling, passenger and crew data. The assistant chief pilot at Clayton Aviation, the flight department of Clayton Homes, said instant currency checks tied to trip requests make scheduling much faster and more reliable. No pricing was published.

whyItMatters: A charter quote you cannot fly because no current crew is available costs you the trip and the client's trust. Checking crew currency at the moment of booking lets you say yes faster to the trips you can actually operate. If your sales team still waits on the chief pilot to confirm crew, time how long that takes, since that delay is where you lose bookings to faster operators.
